reason: The accepted nested CV meets the aggregate sensitivity target, but one of five outer folds is below 0.90 for each method. Alternate woman-fold assignments are the only unresolved check likely to change the Q4 claim.
tested_claim: M4's aggregate sensitivity feasibility and specificity advantage over B4 are not artifacts of the single deterministic woman-fold assignment.

status_rules.PASS: all fits converge; M4 meets aggregate sensitivity >=0.90 with specificity >0 and flagged fraction <0.95 in at least 6/7 seeds; M4 specificity exceeds B4 in at least 6/7 paired seeds; median specificity gain exceeds 0.10
status_rules.CONDITIONAL: all fits converge and both feasibility/dominance counts are at least 5/7, but a PASS condition is missed
status_rules.FAIL: any nonconvergence, feasibility count below 5/7, dominance count below 5/7, or nonpositive median specificity gain

fallback_rule: F4 becomes decision-relevant if the result is FAIL; CONDITIONAL requires a bounded claim that explicitly denies a per-split or per-fold 90% guarantee.
